name: commit-generator
description: Generate Russian Git commit messages through a configurable API.

commitGenerator.apiUrl.description: Full URL of the chat-completions-compatible API endpoint.

commitGenerator.apiKey.description: API key sent to the API. Prefer storing it in user settings, not workspace settings committed to Git.

commitGenerator.apiKeyHeader.description: HTTP header used for the API key.

commitGenerator.apiKeyPrefix.description: Optional value prefix for the API key header. Use an empty value to send the raw key.

commitGenerator.model.description: Optional model name sent in the API request body.

commitGenerator.temperature.description: Sampling temperature sent in the API request body.

commitGenerator.extraBody.description: Optional JSON object merged into the API request body.

commitGenerator.promptTemplate.default:
Сгенерируй сообщение Git-коммита на русском языке для предоставленного diff.

Правила:
- Выведи только сообщение коммита.
- Не используй Conventional Commits или другой формальный шаблон.
- Пиши естественно и кратко, как обычное сообщение коммита.
- Первая строка должна быть не длиннее 72 символов.
- Добавляй короткое тело только если без него изменение непонятно.
- Основывайся только на diff.

Diff mode: {diffMode}

```diff
{diff}
```
commitGenerator.promptTemplate.description: Prompt template sent as the user message. Use {diffMode} and {diff} placeholders to include the selected Git diff.

commitGenerator.diffMode.description: Which Git diff to send to the API. Auto tries staged changes first, then unstaged changes.

commitGenerator.maxDiffBytes.description: Maximum diff size, in bytes, sent to the API.

commitGenerator.timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for the API.
